intro.title: Ecommerce Software Built Around How You Sell
paragraphs: Selling online is about more than a nice storefront. Orders, stock, payments, shipping, returns and marketing all have to work together, every day, at any traffic level. As an ecommerce software development company, we build stores and commerce systems that handle the whole journey, from the first product view to the delivered parcel.

Some businesses outgrow ready-made store builders: per-order fees add up, plugins conflict, and custom pricing, B2B rules or marketplace features simply are not possible. That is where custom ecommerce software pays off. We design your platform around your catalogue, customers and operations, and connect it to the ERP, POS, accounting and delivery partners you already use.

The same team handles UX design, web and mobile app development, integrations, testing and long-term support, with full source-code ownership. See <work>ecommerce projects we have delivered</work>, explore our wider <sd>software development services</sd> or <contact>tell us about your store</contact>.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Quick answers for businesses planning an online store or commerce platform.

items.a: Ecommerce software development is designing and building the systems that let a business sell online: the storefront, mobile app, checkout, payments, order and inventory management, and integrations with shipping, ERP and accounting tools.

items.q: What is the best platform for ecommerce website development?
items.a: It depends on your business. Ready-made store builders suit new and small stores that need to launch quickly. Growing brands, B2B sellers and marketplaces usually get better speed, flexibility and lower long-term costs from a custom ecommerce platform they fully own.

items.q: How much does ecommerce app development cost?
items.a: A custom ecommerce website typically costs $5,000 to $15,000. A website with Android and iOS apps costs $15,000 to $50,000, and B2B or multi-vendor platforms start around $40,000. We share a fixed, itemised estimate after a free discovery call.

items.q: How long does it take to build an ecommerce store?
items.a: A custom ecommerce website usually takes 4 to 8 weeks. Adding mobile apps takes 2 to 4 months in total, and B2B or marketplace platforms take 4 months or more, depending on features and integrations.

items.q: Can you migrate my existing online store to a new platform?
items.a: Yes. We move products, customers and order history from your current platform, set up redirects to protect your Google rankings and switch over with no downtime for shoppers.

items.q: Do you build B2B and multi-vendor marketplace platforms?
items.a: Yes. We build B2B portals with customer-specific pricing, bulk ordering and credit terms, and multi-vendor marketplaces with seller onboarding, commissions, split payments and vendor dashboards.
